part.description: Single-solid prismatic lever/handle-like component with a large rounded head at one end, a long rectangular arm, a right-end mounting face with a blind cylindrical bore, and a rectangular clearance pocket cut into the arm. External edges are heavily radiused/filleted with a mix of cylindrical, spherical, conical, and spline blend faces.
part.symmetry_note: Overall outer form is approximately symmetric about a longitudinal mid-plane for much of the arm, but symmetry is broken by the clearance pocket and local end blends/chamfers.

Section.name: Left Rounded Head
features included: Large end head / grip mass
External corner rounding (R30-class) via cylinders and spherical corner blend
Local small edge rounds (R5-class) near head-arm transition corner
Section.function intent: Provide a robust grasp/impact-resistant mass and a load introduction region for the lever arm, reducing stress concentration via large radii.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as a stiffened mass at the end of the arm; large fillets and smooth blends reduce peak stresses under bending/handling loads and improve durability against knocks.
Section.geometry: Bulky end block with rounded external corners: multiple quarter-cylindrical rounds (radius ~30) and a spherical corner blend (radius ~30), with planar end/front/back/bottom boundary faces. Includes the shoulder plane at the head-to-arm transition (x≈100).
Section.location: Left end of the part (near x=0 to x≈100).

Section.name: Main Arm / Beam Body
features included: Primary prismatic arm spanning the length of the part
Major exterior planar faces (top, bottom, front side, back side)
Longitudinal edge chamfers (top-front and bottom-front)
Section.function intent: Transmit load/motion between the head and the right-end interface while providing a stable rectangular envelope for packaging.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as the main bending member; planar faces provide stiffness and datum-like surfaces, while chamfers reduce edge damage and stress risers at long edges.
Section.geometry: Long rectangular prism-like arm with a continuous planar top face and a planar bottom face, plus planar side faces at constant y. Includes two long 45° chamfer planes along the front/top and front/bottom edges (small-width).
Section.location: Central spanning region from the head shoulder (x≈100) to near the right end (x approaching 300).

Section.name: Right-End Interface / Nose
features included: Right-end mounting face
Local corner chamfers and rounds near the nose
Local step/shoulder plane near the front/underside region
Section.function intent: Provide a defined end interface to mate against/locate a counterpart part and to support the end opening of the mounting bore.
Section.physical behavior: Carries local contact stresses at the end face and distributes them into the arm; local radii and blends mitigate stress concentration near the end interface.
Section.geometry: End plane at x=300 with local edge rounds (R10-class and small R2.5-class) and a small 45° planar chamfer near the end corner. Includes a large exterior cylindrical round (R≈35) and conical blend patches that transition between chamfers/rounds.
Section.location: Rightmost end region of the arm (near x≈290 to x=300).

Section.name: Mounting Bore (Blind Hole)
features included: Blind cylindrical bore along the part length (axis ~x)
Bore bottom/termination face
Section.function intent: Provide a fastener/pin interface for assembly, positioning, or load transfer to a mating component.
Section.physical behavior: The cylindrical wall provides radial constraint and shear load transfer; the bore bottom provides axial stop for a pin/bolt or sets insertion depth (if applicable).
Section.geometry: Internal cylinder of radius ~14.142 (Ø~28.284) running from x=300 back to x=100, terminated by a planar circular bottom face at x=100.
Section.location: Internal feature centered within the arm, spanning from the right end inward to the head-side shoulder region.

major_faces.description: Internal cylindrical face (R≈14.142) with axis along x, defining the main mounting bore.

major_faces.name: Bore bottom face
major_faces.description: Planar circular face at x=100 closing the bore (blind hole termination).

Section.name: Rectangular Clearance Pocket
features included: Rectangular recessed pocket/cavity with flat walls
Local internal planar floors/ceilings and sidewalls
Section.function intent: Provide clearance for an adjacent component or allow engagement/avoid interference (e.g., latch clearance, weight reduction, or access).
Section.physical behavior: Removes material locally to create envelope clearance; introduces local compliance/stress concentration at pocket corners that is managed by surrounding bulk material and blends outside the pocket.
Section.geometry: Open pocket defined by two x-normal side walls (x≈125.35 and x≈168.34), a y-normal end wall (y=280), and two z-normal faces (z≈-374.12 and z≈-405.07) forming the pocket boundaries.
Section.location: On the arm, nearer the head side (approximately x=125–168), inset from the front side (y starting at ~230) and bounded toward y=280.
